summary.headline: Codex Folios 9–230
summary.text: Catalog of codex folios 9–230, listing works on calculation, Indian arithmetic, land measurement, geodesy, geometry, Persian astronomical tables, the Great Syntaxis, astronomical hypotheses, syzygies, and calendar methods. Named authorities include Nicolaus Rhabdas, Maximus Planudes, John Pediasimos, Heron, Isaac Argyri, and Proclus.
